title: Auna Announces 1Q26 Financial Results
summary: Strong top-line growth and cash flow performance; Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA impacted by revenue adjustments; Mexico volumes and revenues growing rapidly, with Segment Adjusted EBITDA increasing 19% QoQ Auna (NYSE: AUNA) (“Auna” or the “Company”) , a leading healthcare platform in Latin America with operations in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia, announced today financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026 (“first quarter 2026” or “1Q26”). Financial results are expressed in Peruvian Soles (“S/” or “PEN” or “Soles”) and are presented in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (“IFRS”), unless otherwise noted. 1Q’26 Consolidated Highlights Revenue increased 10% FXN, or 13% YoY on a reported basis, to S/1,178 million Mexico Revenue increased 15% YoY on a reported basis, to S/ 279 million Adjusted EBITDA was S/217 million, a decrease of 2% YoY Adjusted EBITDA Margin of 18.4%, down 2.9 p.p. YoY from 21.4% in 1Q25 Operating Cash Flow and Free Cash Flow
